theme_and_archetype.rationale: App deals with civic action, which needs a professional and trustworthy structure. It targets youth (16-35) so it must feel energetic and motivating, avoiding clinical or overly bureaucratic aesthetics.

typography.rationale: Mukta and Hind are highly optimized for Devanagari script, offering excellent legibility and a modern, sturdy look that suits a bold youth movement.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous Tailwind spacing like p-4, p-6. Internal padding in cards should be p-5.
layout_and_spacing.app_structure_mobile: The consumer app is a mobile-first interface. In React/Web context, constrain the main app container using `max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#F6F5FA] relative overflow-hidden pb-20 shadow-2xl`.
layout_and_spacing.app_structure_admin: The admin panel should use a standard desktop-first dashboard layout (sidebar + main content area) using full width `min-h-screen flex`.
layout_and_spacing.corners: Rounded aesthetics: `rounded-2xl` for main cards, `rounded-xl` for buttons, `rounded-full` for badges/avatars.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Soft elevation: `shadow-sm` for cards, `shadow-md` for sticky headers/bottom nav.

bottom_navigation.classes: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-[#FFFFFF] border-t border-[#3A1C71]/10 flex justify-between items-center px-6 py-3 z-50

onboarding_images.description: Youth cleaning litter - represents grassroot movement
Volunteer giving thumbs up - represents community action

media_and_images.guidelines: Use solid background colors matching the brand where images are loading. Images MUST have max-h constraints (e.g. max-h-48 on cards). Never stretch images, use object-cover.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case). Example: `data-testid="login-btn"`, `data-testid="nav-home"`, `data-testid="campaign-card-join"`.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast over brand colors. Use #FFFFFF text on #3A1C71 backgrounds. Use #1C1B2E on #F4B400 backgrounds.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use Tailwind's `transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out` for interactive elements.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Wrap main content with simple CSS animations (`animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-300`) to mock screen changes.

specific_screens_instructions.general: The entire UI MUST be in Hindi (Devanagari script) as requested.
specific_screens_instructions.splash: Deep purple background (#3A1C71) with the Logo centered, and Tagline 'युवा जागे, देश बदले' in bright yellow (#F4B400) below it.
specific_screens_instructions.onboarding: Full screen image top (max-h-[50vh]), bottom white sheet with rounded-t-3xl. Bold Hindi typography for motivation, dots for pagination, and 'शुरू करें' (Start) button.
specific_screens_instructions.home_feed: Top header with Purple background, user avatar, and 'नमस्ते' (Hello). Main area: Featured campaign banner (large card, image cover, 'अभियान से जुड़ें' button), followed by 'हाल की समस्याएँ' (Recent issues) horizontal scroll list.
specific_screens_instructions.issue_reporting: Simple multi-step or long form. Big camera placeholder area (upload photo), input for title, dropdown for category (सड़क, पानी, बिजली, सफ़ाई), and text area for details. 'दर्ज करें' submit button.
specific_screens_instructions.admin_dashboard: Separate route/view. Desktop layout. Sidebar with navigation. Overview cards for Total Members, Active Campaigns, Open Issues. Table for recent flagged content.
